summary: Automation built-in nodes, review follow-up (#1417): an Action whose command the workflow sends again after a lost dispatch keeps the call's deadline and holds a call slot (NativeRun.CallDispatches); the http node sends a CEL string of a json body as a JSON string and only a rendered {{ }} template as JSON text (graph.Effect.Templated, catalog.CallInput.Templated); the guarded fetcher caps response headers at 64 KiB (WithMaxHeaderBytes, ErrResponseHeadersTooLarge) and the http node's output budget counts them; NUL normalization (pkg/jsonb) never merges two keys, and the workflow's occurrence errors, failed and blocked details, a call's error code and unknown-outcome message and an SDK action's invalid_args message are written with U+FFFD; run_automation finds every waiting ancestor of a conversation down to Limits.MaxDepth instead of 64 levels.
